adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts, the refreshOAuthTokens function wraps the original token refresh call. When APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true and CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT is set, refreshOAuthTokens returns a fetch Response object from the credential sync endpoint (lines 6-14 in refreshOAuthTokens.ts). However, the HubSpot code at line 177 expects the return value to be a HubspotToken object with specific fields like accessToken, refreshToken, expiresIn. The credential sync endpoint returns a different response format, so treating it as HubspotToken would result in undefined fields being used for token storage and subsequent API calls.
